# Calculatorship.in
> Independent, free financial calculators and educational guides for Indian citizens, salaried professionals, and long-term investors.

Calculatorship is a self-funded financial calculation and research project created by Tejas (an engineering student based in India). The platform provides accurate calculators, step-by-step mathematical proofs, tax comparisons under Indian law (Old vs New Tax Regime, Budget revisions, Income-tax Act transitions), and educational guides cross-referenced with statutory notifications.

## Core Calculators

- [SIP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/): Systematic Investment Plan compound interest projections with historical CAGR benchmarks and equity taxation.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/lumpsum.html): One-time mutual fund compounding calculator with year-by-year accumulation tables.
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/step-up.html): Top-up SIP calculator modeling annual percentage increments matching salary hikes.
- [Target Goal Planner](https://www.calculatorship.in/goal.html): Reverse SIP calculation to estimate monthly savings required for future inflation-adjusted goals.
- [PPF Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/ppf-calculator.html): Public Provident Fund sovereign wealth growth at 7.1% per annum with 5th-of-the-month rules and 15-30 year schedules.
- [SWP Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/swp-calculator.html): Systematic Withdrawal Plan simulator with longevity analysis and post-tax cash flows.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/emi-calculator.html): Reducing-balance loan amortization schedules with prepayment impact analysis.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/fd-calculator.html): Cumulative vs quarterly payout fixed deposit maturity calculator.
- [50/30/20 Budget Planner](https://www.calculatorship.in/budget-planner.html): Monthly salary allocation into Needs, Wants, and Investments.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/income-tax-calculator.html): Side-by-side comparison of Old vs New Tax Regime for FY 2026-27 with Section 87A rebate and marginal relief.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/gratuity-calculator.html): Payment of Gratuity Act 15/26 formula calculator with ₹20 Lakh tax exemption rules.
- [GST Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/gst-calculator.html): Inclusive and exclusive GST calculator with CGST, SGST, and IGST breakdowns.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/compound-interest-calculator.html): Universal compound interest calculator with daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual compounding frequencies.
- [Recurring Deposit (RD) Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/rd-calculator.html): Bank RD maturity calculator with quarterly compounding rules as followed by Indian banks.
- [NPS Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/nps-calculator.html): National Pension System retirement corpus projections and lump-sum vs annuity distributions.
- [EPF Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/epf-calculator.html): Employee Provident Fund accumulation at current 8.25% interest with employer/EPS split.
- [HRA Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/hra-calculator.html): House Rent Allowance tax exemption calculator under Section 10(13A) and Rule 2A.
- [In-Hand Salary Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/in-hand-salary-calculator.html): CTC-to-in-hand salary conversion with PF, Gratuity, Professional Tax, and Income Tax deductions.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/cagr-calculator.html): Compound Annual Growth Rate and reverse CAGR calculator.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/simple-interest-calculator.html): Straightforward SI calculator for loans, promissory notes, and fixed yields.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://www.calculatorship.in/inflation-calculator.html): Future purchasing power and target wealth requirement calculator based on historical Indian CPI inflation.

## Guide Categories & Knowledge Hubs

- [All Financial Guides & Articles](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html): Complete, searchable directory of 152+ in-depth educational articles.
- [Calculators Directory](https://www.calculatorship.in/calculators.html): Categorized index of all tools by domain (Investing, Loans, Tax, Retirement, Salary).
- [Tax & Financial Planning Guides](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html#tax): Advance tax, capital gains, Section 80C, 80D, 80CCD, HRA, and tax regime comparisons.
- [SIP & Mutual Fund Guides](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html#sip): Direct vs regular plans, expense ratios, index funds, arbitrage funds, and portfolio rebalancing.
- [Retirement & Pension](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html#retirement): APY, NPS, EPF withdrawal norms, FIRE in India, and senior citizen schemes.
- [Loans & Real Estate](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html#loans): Home loan prepayment vs SIP, CIBIL score blueprints, balance transfers, and car loans.
- [Fixed Income & Savings Schemes](https://www.calculatorship.in/blog.html#savings): PPF, Sukanya Samriddhi (SSY), NSC, SCSS, POTD, and Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB).

## Editorial & Transparency Standards

- [About Calculatorship](https://www.calculatorship.in/about.html): Creator background, motivation, and independence declaration.
- [Editorial Policy & Verification](https://www.calculatorship.in/editorial-policy.html): How statutory numbers and formulas are checked against Ministry and Regulator circulars.
- [Corrections Policy & Changelog](https://www.calculatorship.in/corrections.html): Transparent error correction mechanism and public record.
- [Contact & Error Reporting](https://www.calculatorship.in/contact.html): Direct line for reporting numerical inconsistencies or regulatory updates.
